tweaks.name: Remove forced HPET clock (bcdedit useplatformclock)
tweaks.why: Forcing HPET as the main clock is an old 'FPS tweak' that adds timer read overhead and can hurt frame pacing. Windows picks the best clock source by default.

tweaks.name: Re-enable the page file (system managed)
tweaks.why: Running with no page file makes games and browsers crash or stutter when memory commit runs out. A system-managed page file is the safe default even with lots of RAM.

tweaks.name: Restore CPU security mitigations (Spectre/Meltdown)
tweaks.why: Something turned off CPU security mitigations. That is a real security hole and some anti-cheats look at it. This removes the override so Windows uses its defaults.

tweaks.name: Reset LargeSystemCache to the desktop default
tweaks.why: LargeSystemCache=1 is a server setting that favors file cache over applications. On a gaming PC it can take memory from the game and add stutter.

tweaks.name: Re-enable the Windows Update service
tweaks.why: Windows Update was disabled (usually by an old debloat tool). Without it you miss security fixes, and anti-cheats like Vanguard and FACEIT can refuse to run on outdated builds.

tweaks.name: Re-enable the BITS service
tweaks.why: Background Intelligent Transfer Service was disabled. Windows Update, the Store and several game launchers need it to download.

tweaks.name: Reset Win32PrioritySeparation to the Windows default
tweaks.why: An unusual value from an old tweak tool was found. The Windows client default (2) already gives the foreground game a boost; odd values can make background work starve or stutter.
